notes: `markTypes` and the selector tokens come from the parser (vega-event-selector); event types, named sources and object properties come from the doc page.
`markEventTypes` applies only to events on scenegraph items (marks, view, scope). Other DOM sources (`window`, a CSS selector) accept any event type the browser fires.
Every example's `parsed` is the output of the Python port of the parser in scripts/vega_language.py.

objectProperties.name: source
objectProperties.description: The input event source. For event streams defined in the top-level scope of a Vega specification, this property defaults to `"view"`, which monitors all input events in the current Vega view component (including those targeting the containing Canvas or SVG component itself). For event streams defined within nested scopes, this property defaults to `"scope"`, which limits consideration to only events originating within the group in which the event stream is defined. Othe legal values include `"window"` for the browser window object, `"container"` for the DOM element containing the view (`"resize"` events only), or a [CSS selector](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_Selectors) string indicating external DOM elements. The source property is ignored if the event _type_ is `"timer"`.

objectProperties.name: type
objectProperties.description: The event type to monitor (e.g., `"click"`, `"keydown"`, `"timer"`). For more, see the [supported event types list](https://vega.github.io/vega/docs/event-streams/#types).

objectProperties.name: between
objectProperties.description: A two-element array of event stream objects, indicating sentinel starting and ending events. Only events that occur between these two events will be captured.

objectProperties.name: consume
objectProperties.description: A boolean flag (default `false`) indicating if this stream should consume the event by invoking [`event.preventDefault()`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Event/preventDefault). To control event consumption more globally, see the [event handling configuration](https://vega.github.io/vega/docs/config/#events).

objectProperties.name: filter
objectProperties.description: One or more filter expressions, each of which must evaluate to a truthy value in order for the event to be captured. These expressions may **not** reference signal values, only event properties.

objectProperties.name: debounce
objectProperties.description: The minimum time to wait between event occurrence and processing. If a new event arrives during a debouncing window, the debounce timer will restart and only the new event will be captured.

objectProperties.name: markname
objectProperties.description: The unique name of a mark set for which to monitor input events. Events originating from other marks will be ignored.

objectProperties.name: marktype
objectProperties.description: The type or marks (`arc`, `rect`, _etc._) to monitor for input events. Events originating from other mark types will be ignored.

objectProperties.name: throttle
objectProperties.description: The minimum time in milliseconds between captured events (default `0`). New events that arrive within the throttling window will be ignored. For timer events, this property determines the interval between timer ticks.

objectProperties.name: stream
objectProperties.description: An input event stream to modify with additional parameters.

objectProperties.name: merge
objectProperties.description: An array of event streams to merge into a single stream.
